expectations.note: Cross-folder crumb action was present; activation changed /opt/nothingness to /opt/nothingness/media and exposed the playing track folder.
In the already-correct folder, the offscreen playing track exposed the accessible action and activation scrolled the list to the track without changing the folder.
After the track was fully visible, the semantics bundle showed the row within the viewport and no active jump action.
Clean idle captures at both /opt/nothingness and /opt/nothingness/media had songInfo null and no jump affordance.
The active action appeared in the semantics tree as a button labeled scroll to now playing with a descriptive hint.
The candidate's submitted before_now_playing_row.png shows playback active and the playing row absent from the visible list while the action is shown.

The candidate's submitted after_now_playing_row.png is effectively the same pre-jump frame and does not show the playing row; my live post-jump capture does, but it is not the candidate's submitted after screenshot.
The implementation claims were partly traceable, but the candidate's live tap of its action failed and its final write-up claimed an after screenshot that did not evidence the transition.
An on-screen folder-row tap navigated correctly, and queued playback pause/resume/next/prev controls remained responsive with the expected active queue state.
The final app remained live and responsive, and overflow reports were empty after exercising the feature and controls.
